name: REANIMATION PROTOCOLS
text: The first time each friendly Hierotek Circle operative is incapacitated, a Reanimation marker is left beside it. In each Ready step, after Living Metal, one marker is rolled for: on 3+ its operative returns with 1 wound, within 3 inches of the marker and outside enemy control ranges, with an order of your choice. The opponent's kill grade falls when it returns. An operative incapacitated a second time is gone for good.

name: LIVING METAL
text: In each Ready step, before every other rule of this team in that step, each friendly Hierotek Circle operative regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, rolled separately.

name: Magnify
text: When shooting with this weapon, a friendly Apprentek or Cryptek with an Engage order that is outside enemy control ranges and visible to the shooter may stand in as the viewpoint for target validity, the Shoot conditions, cover and obscured. The weapon then has Ceaseless for the action. Ranges, Blast, Devastating and other distances still use the real shooter.

name: Scuttler
text: While it has a Conceal order and is in cover this operative cannot be chosen as a target unless the shooter is within 2 inches, whatever Seek or Vantage says. Fall Back costs it 1 less AP. It uses only the weapons on its datacard and no unique action but its own.

name: Apprentek Assistance
text: This operative has every unique action of the Cryptek in your kill team, but may perform only one of them per turning point. Distances and expiry on such an action are measured from and tied to the Apprentek. It is not a Cryptek for any other rule.

name: Deathmarked
text: When this operative finishes a Shoot action, the target (the primary target if there were several) gains your Deathmarked token if it was not incapacitated. The token lasts the battle. A friendly Deathmark shooting an enemy with the token has Seek on its ranged weapons.

name: Steadfast
text: When control of a marker is worked out you may count this operative's APL as 3, ignoring all changes to its APL. Terror or Despair modifiers on the total still apply afterwards.

name: INTERSTITIAL COMMAND
text: Pick another friendly Hierotek Circle operative that is not an Apprentek or Cryptek and is visible to and within 6 inches of this operative, or visible to and within 6 inches of a friendly Despotek that this operative can see. It performs one 1 AP action for free, moving no more than 2 inches. It may not pick an action it has done this turning point and cannot do that action again this turning point. Not in an enemy control range or while counteracting.

name: INTERSTITIAL COMMAND
text: Pick another friendly Hierotek Circle operative that is not an Apprentek or Cryptek and is visible to and within 6 inches of this operative. It performs one 1 AP action for free (not Accelerate), moving no more than 2 inches. It may not pick an action it has done this turning point and cannot do that action again this turning point. Not in an enemy control range or while counteracting.

name: TIMESPLINTER
text: Pick another friendly Hierotek Circle operative that is expended and visible to and within 5 inches of this operative. Remove it and set it up again anywhere it can be placed that is visible to and within 5 inches (horizontally) of this operative. Only once per turning point for the whole team, never in the first turning point, not in an enemy control range.

name: COUNTERTEMPORAL NANOMINE
text: Place your Nanomine marker within 8 inches of this operative, visible to it or on Vantage terrain of a visible terrain feature. While an enemy operative is within 4 inches of the marker its Move is 2 inches lower. The marker goes when this operative next activates, when it is incapacitated, or when a friendly operative performs this action again. Not in an enemy control range.

name: CHRONOMETRON
text: Pick a friendly Hierotek Circle operative (it may be this one) visible to and within 6 inches. Until this operative next activates, is incapacitated, or a friendly operative performs this action again, every weapon has 1 less Atk while it shoots, fights or retaliates against the picked operative. Not in an enemy control range.

name: HARBINGER OF DESPAIR
text: Place your Despair marker where this operative can see it, or on Vantage terrain of a visible terrain feature. While an enemy operative is within 2 inches of it, Pick Up Marker and mission actions cost that operative 1 extra AP, and the enemy's contesting APL total for a marker is 1 lower if any of its contesting operatives is within 2 inches of the Despair marker. It goes when this operative next activates, is incapacitated, or a friendly operative repeats the action. Not in an enemy control range.

name: NIGHTMARE SHROUD
text: Until this operative next activates, is incapacitated, or a friendly operative repeats this action: whenever an enemy operative within 4 inches of this operative shoots, fights or retaliates, its dice cannot be re-rolled for any reason and no result below 6 can be kept as a critical success. Not in an enemy control range.

name: VISION OF MADNESS
text: Pick an enemy operative visible to this operative; it gains your Madness token until this operative next activates, is incapacitated, or a friendly operative repeats this action. When the opponent would activate the token holder you roll a D6: on a result equal to or higher than its APL it cannot activate this time and the opponent must pick another operative. The token is removed when the holder activates or no other enemy operative can. Not in an enemy control range.

name: CANOPTEK REPAIR
text: Pick a friendly Hierotek Circle operative (it may be this one) visible to and within 6 inches. It regains up to 2D3 lost wounds. Only once per turning point for the whole team. Not in an enemy control range.

name: AUGMENT WEAPON
text: Pick a friendly Hierotek Circle operative (it may be this one) visible to and within 6 inches, then one weapon on its datacard, then two of Lethal 5+, Rending, Saturate and Severe. Until this operative next activates, is incapacitated, or a friendly operative repeats this action, that weapon has both. For a staff of light or an arcane conduit pick one profile only. Not in an enemy control range.

name: REINFORCE METAL
text: Pick a friendly Hierotek Circle operative (it may be this one) visible to and within 6 inches. Until this operative next activates, is incapacitated, or a friendly operative repeats this action, each attack die that would deal 3 or more damage to the picked operative deals 1 less. Devastating damage is not reduced. Not in an enemy control range.

name: ACCELERATE
text: Pick a friendly Deathmark or Immortal visible to and within 6 inches. It gains 1 APL until the end of its next activation. Not in an enemy control range.

name: REANIMATE
text: Pick one of your Reanimation markers visible to and within 6 inches. For 1 AP roll a D6: on 3+ the operative tied to the marker is reanimated. For 2 AP it is reanimated without a roll. If it was already expended this turning point it returns expended, otherwise ready. Not in an enemy control range.

name: MULTI-DIMENSIONAL VISION
text: Until the start of this operative's next activation, enemies it shoots cannot be obscured. Not in an enemy control range.
